  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "The {{ing_01|pig}} is boned through the throat and filled with {{ing_02|quenelles of chicken forcemeat}}, {{ing_03|finely cut (roast) thrushes}}, {{ing_04|fig-peckers}}, {{ing_05|little sausage cakes}}, made of the {{ing_01|pig’s meat}}, {{ing_06|Lucanian sausage}}, {{ing_07|stoned dates}}, {{ing_08|edible bulbs (glazed onions)}}, {{ing_09|snails taken out of the shell (and poached)}}, {{ing_10|mallows}}, {{ing_11|leeks}}, {{ing_12|beets}}, {{ing_13|celery}}, {{ing_14|cooked sprouts}}, {{ing_15|coriander}}, {{ing_16|whole pepper}}, {{ing_17|nuts}}, {{ing_18|15 eggs}} poured over, {{ing_19|broth}}, which is spiced with {{ing_20|pepper}}, and diluted with {{ing_21|3 eggs}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Thereupon sew it tight, stiffen, and roast in the oven."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "When done, open the back (of the {{ing_01|pig}}) and pour over the following sauce: crushed {{ing_20|pepper}}, {{ing_22|rue}}, {{ing_19|broth}}, {{ing_23|raisin wine}}, {{ing_24|honey}} and a little {{ing_25|oil}}, which when boiling is tied with {{ing_26|roux}}."
    }
  ],
